AB507.title: AB 507 · Office to Housing Conversion Act
AB507.check: Operative 1 July 2026. Verify the existing use, infill, unit affordability, labour, site and historic-resource tests. Older age triggers the applicable historic review, not automatic rejection. Hotels and mixed-use buildings containing hotel use must satisfy the statutory five-year discontinuation test.

SB6.title: SB 6 · Middle Class Housing Act
SB6.check: Confirm that office, retail or parking is allowed, and check site, density and labour requirements. SB 6 establishes a permitted residential use in eligible commercial zones. Ministerial review or a CEQA exemption needs a separate basis.

AB1490.title: AB 1490 · Extremely affordable adaptive reuse
AB1490.check: Verify a residential or commercial building that already allows temporary dwelling or occupancy. Test conversion within the existing envelope, 100% lower-income units and at least 50% very-low-income units, plus affordability and site conditions. Ordinary office occupancy is insufficient.

AB2011.title: AB 2011 · Affordable Housing and High Road Jobs Act
AB2011.check: Check the 100% affordable commercial-land route or the mixed-income commercial-corridor route and amendments for mall sites. Confirm frontage, source zoning, industrial adjacency, freeway conditions, affordability and labour. A commercial zoning label alone cannot establish eligibility.

HOMEKEY.title: Homekey · Acquisition and conversion funding
HOMEKEY.check: Review the applicable notice of funding availability, eligible applicant or public partner, target population and operating plan. A nearby motel conversion is precedent only. An award, active funding round or entitlement has not been established.

SA_REUSE.title: Santa Ana · Adaptive Reuse Ordinance §§41-1651–1652
SA_REUSE.check: Confirm a designated incentive area: Midtown SP3, Transit SD84, or the specified North Main or East First corridor segment. Verify pre-1 July 1974 building-code vintage or historic significance, then check minimum unit size, street-front commercial requirements, seismic and fire review.

SA_P.title: Santa Ana · Professional district, §§41-312–313.5
SA_P.check: The base P district lists office and service uses. Establish a separate residential route or overlay before presenting apartments as permitted. Section 41-321’s rule for converting existing residential buildings to professional uses does not establish the reverse conversion.

SA_SP3.title: Santa Ana · Midtown Specific Plan (SP3)
SA_SP3.check: Locate the parcel within the plan and confirm the applicable subarea, adopted amendments and use table. SP3 also falls in the local adaptive-reuse incentive area; building eligibility and project design still matter.

SA_OZ1.title: Santa Ana · Metro East Mixed Use Overlay
SA_OZ1.check: Check the city’s adopted Metro East use and development standards and the parcel’s exact overlay subarea. This state record documents the overlay’s purpose and is not project approval.

SA_SD84.title: Santa Ana · Transit Zoning Code (SD84)
SA_SD84.check: Determine the regulating-plan sub-zone, building type, street frontage and use-permit requirements. SD84 also identifies a local adaptive-reuse incentive area.

SA_CODE.title: Santa Ana Municipal Code · Chapter 41
SA_CODE.check: Read the current permitted uses and overlays for the mapped district; confirm the source parcel identity and any development agreement.

CC01_CEQA.title: 1200 N Main · City-filed project-specific CEQA notice
CC01_CEQA.check: The notice describes DP-2025-9-CHG and 184 proposed units. Match the project plans and addresses; the filing is not a building permit, a financing commitment, or evidence of eligibility for another site. The notice and listing report different building areas.

ANA_COMMERCIAL.title: Anaheim · Table 8-A, §18.08.030
ANA_COMMERCIAL.check: For C-G and O-L, the multifamily dwelling row is marked permitted with special provisions. Check the General Plan designation and implementing zone under §18.08.030.150 where applicable; conversions of motels, commercial and office structures can engage §18.38.215.

ORANGE_CODE.title: Orange · Title 17 zoning regulations
ORANGE_CODE.check: Check the C-2 use table, parcel overlays and current density standards. A commercial listing or neighbourhood name does not establish multifamily permission.

TUSTIN_CODE.title: Tustin · Municipal Code
TUSTIN_CODE.check: Check Article 9, Chapter 2 and any governing planned-community plan. PC COM identifies planned commercial use; confirm the site’s adopted use list.

TUSTIN_PR.title: Tustin · §9231 Professional District (Pr)
TUSTIN_PR.check: Section 9231 lists professional offices and single-family dwellings subject to R1 conditions. Confirm the parcel designation and adopted amendments. The Pr label does not establish that a multifamily conversion is permitted.

WESTMINSTER_CODE.title: Westminster · Zoning Code
WESTMINSTER_CODE.check: Read the applicable commercial-district use table and specific-plan or overlay provisions. Verify housing use and approval type independently.

GG_GGMU1.title: Garden Grove · Mixed-use district use matrix
GG_GGMU1.check: Read Table 9.18-1 for the GGMU-1 column and related operating conditions. Verify the motel’s operating history, proposed housing type and entitlement route separately.

SA_C1.title: Santa Ana · Community Commercial (C1)
SA_C1.check: Start with §41-365’s permitted uses and the conditional-use provisions in the city handout. Verify the proposed residential use or a separate housing pathway.

SA_C2.title: Santa Ana · General Commercial (C2)
SA_C2.check: The C2 use list incorporates permitted C1 uses and includes additional commercial uses. Check the C2 provisions and any site overlay before treating residential conversion as allowed.

ORANGE_C2.title: Orange · Commercial districts, Chapter 17.18
ORANGE_C2.check: Check the C2 use table, dimensional standards and any site-specific overlays. Confirm the housing approval route with the city.

WESTMINSTER_C1.title: Westminster · Commercial districts, Chapter 17.220
WESTMINSTER_C1.check: Check the C1 column of the commercial use table and the applicable development standards. Verify the proposal’s use and permit requirements.
